notes: Dev ABox revision whose edited relation carries functionality: assassinated_in is functional (one city), so the old value is ruled out. Related near asks it as a practical check (application on functional): a Dallas tour guide's claim, yes before and no after; its fact is the original edited fact, as in the README's functional example (is Canberra the capital of Australia?). Related far reaches Kennedy through a role he holds as a separate fact, the 35th president (binding), and its original answer is stored: Wikipedia's assassination article uses that very description. The derived queries are worked out: two compositions that follow the edit to the new city and look up a stored fact about it (its NFL and NBA teams) and a binding through his best-known quotation. Chicago was chosen because it has one NFL and one NBA team named for it; Los Angeles was avoided (Robert F. Kennedy was assassinated there), and the NFL question asks for the team that carries the city's name because the Cowboys play in Arlington. Unrelated near shares the subject; its answer (1963) differs from the new answer. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate. Audit fix 2026-11-12: the tour-guide framing ('Is the guide right?') was answered 'No' by Qwen3, Llama and Mistral (they read 'their city' as a claim about another place), so the question is now the plain 'Was John F. Kennedy assassinated in Dallas?' (yes before, no after); task is now answer. Related[1] added 2026-11-14 (second stored one-hop question, different derivation from related[0]).
